Author: Serpens66
Name: MPTest
Description: Tests opcode 111 as a native multiplayer Chore without changing game state; singleplayer keeps the woodcutter swordsman action.

Changes: Add an optional button-triggered full Chore traffic capture with exact metadata, SHA-256 payload hashes, bounded byte dumps, and managed GameAction observations.
Reuse the existing MPTest send and receive hooks so full capture does not install parallel Chore detours.
Enable a comprehensive 500 ms non-host barrier test profile by default.
Queue five no-op Chores per multiplayer button click to test batching and ordering.
Log barrier-before-release, real hold time, stalled ticks, reinjection, duplicate execution, and tick invariants.
Compare only the latest map containing probe executions so multiple tests in one process do not collide.
Replace the multiplayer spawn with a strictly version-gated native opcode-111 no-op Chore probe.
Log native command IDs, scheduled ticks, SyncEvent barriers, and actual execution ticks.
Add an optional client-side incoming Chore delay for lockstep barrier tests.
Schedule multiplayer spawns for one shared future map tick with the lowest tested safe lead.
Add a synchronized woodcutter-hut button for spawning one swordsman on a valid adjacent tile.
